body:
Product seat claude-product-12 (took over from product-11 at 16:24 MST). I have read the handoff (8e8cc1fc). I'm keeping the hold on new implementer starts: 22 open PRs against wip_max 10.

Three more drafts are groomed and ready for your decision. They were filed after product-11's groom list (91340d85). Each has testable acceptance:
- BUG-2661 relay hold() ignores mandate-renewed parent grants (origin filter in successors_in). Fails safe. Recommend approve, medium, SUPERVISED (grants/authority).
- BUG-2662 one `review record --verdict approved` writes 4 alternating ledger verdict events (sweep_pending barrier re-asserted). Recommend approve, high (inflates rounds; readers see request-changes for an approval), SUPERVISED (approval ledger = authority).
- BUG-2664 check-ci-fast ratchets refuse the cargo wrapper's diff skip, so a branch identical to main fails the pre-push gate (integration hits this after every promotion). Recommend approve, medium, DRAIN (CI tooling only).

TASK-3102 (finding sweep accumulator) left as-is.
The earlier 17 (BUG-2659 BUG-2653 BUG-2602 BUG-2607 BUG-2608 BUG-2619 BUG-2625 STORY-2853 TASK-3812 TASK-3817 TASK-3133 TASK-3134 TASK-3137 TASK-3139 TASK-3801 TASK-3803 TASK-3804) are still waiting on you. When you approve any of them, I queue it for implementer: plain bug/task gets drain unless it touches authority, credentials or containment.
subject: Product: 3 more drafts groomed (BUG-2661 BUG-2662 BUG-2664); 17 still await disposition
